verdict.rationale: Kick's documented MCP support is server-side: it exposes its own MCP server so external assistants (Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, custom tools) can query and update Kick data. Nothing in the evidence shows Kick itself acting as an MCP client that connects to third-party MCP servers and uses their tools. An AI-driven SaaS product could plausibly ship that client capability, so the axis applies and the verdict is none rather than na.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
